title: "prelim-analysis"
format: html

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidydr)
library(gtsummary)
library(here)

cohort = readRDS(here::here("data", "participants_cleaned.rds"))
rnaseq = readRDS(here::here("data", "rnaseq.rds"))
vaccine_hist = readRDS(here::here("data", "vaccine_hist.rds"))

result = left_join(cohort, rnaseq, by = "participant_id") %>%
  group_by(participant_id, biological_sex, n_prior_vax) %>%
  summarise(
    n_unique_genes = n_distinct(ensembl_gene_id),
    counts = sum(counts)
  )

cohort
rnaseq %>%
  group_by(material) %>%
  summarise(
    counts = n()
  )
result


ct <- cor.test(result$n_prior_vax, result$counts, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)

p_lib_vax <- ggplot(result, aes(x = factor(n_prior_vax), y = counts / 1e6)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "col", fill = "#4C72B0", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.25, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 2, alpha = 0.7, colour = "grey20") +
  labs(
    title    = "Total RNA-seq transcript counts by vaccination history",
    subtitle = sprintf("Mean ± SE, points show participants (n = %d); Spearman's rho = %.2f, p = %.2f",
                       nrow(result), ct$estimate, ct$p.value),
    x        = "Number of prior seasonal influenza vaccinations",
    y        = "Total transcript counts (millions)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "grey40"),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

p_lib_vax


rnaseq

vaccine_hist
```

```{r}

# visualizing some data

cohort
cohort$log_freq = log(cohort$value)
# cohort$value = cohort$value*10

plasmablast_propo_hist = ggplot(cohort, aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 29, fill = "#4C72B0", colour = "white", alpha = 0.9) + 
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of plasmablast frequency at day 7",
    subtitle = paste0("n = ", nrow(cohort), " participants"),
    x = "Plasmablast frequency (%)",
    y = "Number of participants"
  ) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(here("output", "plasmablast_propo_hist.png"))
```

```{r}
p_sex <- ggplot(cohort, aes(x = biological_sex)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#4C72B0", colour = "white", alpha = 0.9, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(stat = "count",
            aes(label = paste0(after_stat(count), " (",
                               round(100 * after_stat(count) / nrow(cohort)), "%)")),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Sex distribution of the cohort",
    subtitle = paste0("n = ", nrow(cohort), " participants"),
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Number of participants"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(colour = "grey40"),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(here("output","p_sex.png"))
```

```{r}

rnaseq
rnaseq %>%
  group_by(participant_id,ensembl_gene_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_unique_genes = n_distinct(ensembl_gene_id),
    counts = sum(counts)
  )

rnaseq

table1 = cohort %>%
  select(age, biological_sex, n_prior_vax, value) %>%
  tbl_summary()

table1 <- cohort %>%
  select(age, biological_sex, n_prior_vax, value, subject) %>%
  mutate(
    n_prior_vax = if_else(
      subject %in% vaccine_hist$subject,
      n_prior_vax,
      NA_real_
    )
) %>%
select(-subject) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    type = list(n_prior_vax ~ "continuous"),
    label = list(
      age            ~ "Age (years)",
      biological_sex ~ "Sex",
      n_prior_vax    ~ "Number of prior vaccinations",
      value          ~ "Plasmablast frequency at day 7 (%)"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous()  ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits  = list(value ~ 4),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Unknown"
  )  %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 1. Characteristics of the study cohort**")
table1


gt::gtsave(as_gt(table1), here("output", "table1.png"))
```

```{r}
# Create Table 1 using documented vaccination histories only
table1 <- cohort %>%
  select(age, biological_sex, n_prior_vax, value, subject) %>%
  mutate(
    n_prior_vax = if_else(
      subject %in% vaccine_hist$subject,
      n_prior_vax,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-subject) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    type = list(n_prior_vax ~ "continuous"),
    label = list(
      age            ~ "Age (years)",
      biological_sex ~ "Sex",
      n_prior_vax    ~ "Number of prior vaccinations",
      value          ~ "Plasmablast frequency at day 7 (%)"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous()  ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = list(value ~ 4),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Unknown"
  ) %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_caption("**Table 1. Characteristics of the study cohort**")

# Display table
table1

# Save table as PNG
dir.create(here("output"), showWarnings = FALSE)

gt::gtsave(
  as_gt(table1),
  here("output", "table1.png")
)
```
